title: Vermilla and Joe Johnson the trombonist
summary: He does not know Vermilla; the interviewers identify a trombonist, Joe Johnson, from Algiers who worked with him.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: I don't know who Vermilla is. I don't know who Vermilla is. I asked him who Vermilla is. We talked about him earlier. V-Vernimilla? Vermilla is all the names. Permilla, Vermilla?
Who is Vermilla? Vermilla. Vermilla? Yeah. I don't think I know him. He said you talk about him once. I don't know him. I don't know him. Vermilla.
Vermilla, maybe? Oh, okay. I don't know him. Do you know a trombone player from Algiers named Joe? Joe? The trombone player from Algiers named Joe?
Joe? Maybe we called him something else. All I know is Hanks and Yanks. That's all the true trombone player. Buddy?
Buddy Johnson, Yanks' brother. Yanks' brother? Buddy Johnson. Oh, it ain't Joe Johnson, is it?
I know Joe was a trombone player. He's dead too. I met him around in the hospital. He told me he was dead. Tall, dog fella. I don't know him. He came from over to West Regal. But he moved over here.

His name is Joe Johnson. So who did he work with? He used to work with us. You know, with kid hours. And him and I went to... He did a little bit in us. Very fast. He got hit, man. Yeah, we got... Anderson, he used to work with us too. Andrew Anderson. You know what he said? We kind of had a fight, you know? Yeah. He used to work with us too.
